# AMEVA-MCP-Hub (v3.0.0)
> Zero-Install Universal Polyglot WASM & Multi-Repo Model Context Protocol Hub

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/ameva-mcp-hub
- Installation: `npx ameva-mcp-hub
# or SDK:
npm install ameva-mcp-hub`
- Architecture: Executes WASI WebAssembly bytecodes in-memory inside a single Node process (<1ms) with live GitHub multi-repo tool synchronization.
